Statement uses the Total Governmental Funds column (pp4-5, original pp8-9). Reclassification column eliminates the 155,000 General-to-Activities transfer, so transfers_in/out are null. 'Support services - Students' 1,258,631 split into General Fund 580,664 and Activities Fund 677,967 (student activities) using the fund columns. Nonrevenue receipts 4,627 split into sale of property 4,025 and other 602 (p11). Other support services 308,703 includes 66,420 Depreciation Fund purchases (Depreciation is a sub-fund of the General Fund per combining schedule p7-9), kept under support services as printed. Detail: the General Fund budget-and-actual schedule (pp10-13) is recorded (more detailed, with budgets); the General Fund combining schedule (pp7-9) is not duplicated. Program lines carry no object breakdown, so 'not itemized'. Budget column on some group heading rows (support services - students 275,000, instruction 210,000, central 175,000, plant 775,000, federal 400,000) not attributed to lines. Activities Fund has only a one-line schedule. Printed rounding differences of 1 in Special Building disbursements and QCPUF receipts listed in report_discrepancies.
